summary.en: NWOBHM gallop, thrash precision, twin-guitar harmony, late hard-rock hits.
summary.zh: NWOBHM 疾驰、Thrash 精度、双吉他和声，以及晚期硬摇滚热单。

sound.en: Palm-muted gallop, thrash downpicking, drop-tuned swagger, shred solos
sound.zh: 闷音疾驰、Thrash 下拨、降调姿态、Shred Solo

body.en:
Metal hardens into separate circuits: NWOBHM gallop and twin leads, Bay Area thrash tempo and precision, later groove metal down-tuning. Guns N' Roses lands late-eighties hard rock on MTV before grunge takes US radio.

Kept separate from punk so speed-and-attitude and armor-and-technique are not filed as one exit.
body.zh:
金属硬化成多条线路：NWOBHM 疾驰与双主音、湾区 Thrash 的速度与精度、后来 Groove Metal 的降调。Guns N' Roses 在 Grunge 占据美国电台之前，把晚期硬摇滚送上 MTV。

与朋克分开，免得「速度+态度」和「铠甲+技巧」被归档成同一条出路。
